items.title: 14.3.6 Angle Between Two Vectors (Cross Product) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Dot product se humne do vectors ke darmiyan angle ka cosine nikala tha. Ab cross product se usi angle ka sine nikalenge. Is sabaq mein chaar kitabi misaalein hain: ek hisaab wali, do saboot (proof) wali jo trigonometry ke mashhoor formulas ko vectors se saabit karti hain, aur ek determinant ki practice.

Kitab kehti hai: do vectors \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) ke darmiyan angle cross product ki definition se maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Agar \(\theta\) un ke darmiyan angle ho, to \(|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}| = |\underline{a}||\underline{b}|\sin\theta\), is liye

blocks.text_alt: sine theta equals the magnitude of a cross b divided by the product of the magnitudes of a and b

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh formula kahan se aaya? \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = (|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|\sin\theta)\underline{n}\) ki dono taraf lambai lein. \(|\underline{n}| = 1\) hai, is liye woh ghaib ho jata hai, aur \(0 \le \theta \le \pi\) mein \(\sin\theta\) negative nahin hota. Phir dono taraf \(|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|\) se divide kar diya.
Dhyan dein: sirf sine se angle pakka nahin hota, kyun ke \(\theta\) aur \(180^{\circ} - \theta\) dono ka sine barabar hai (jaise \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \sin 150^{\circ} = \tfrac12\)). Agar angle khud chahiye to 14.2 wala \(\cos\theta = \underline{a} \cdot \underline{b}/(|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|)\) istemal karein, ya kam az kam \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b}\) ka sign dekh lein: positive ho to angle acute (90 se chhota), negative ho to obtuse (90 se bara).

Ab Example 16 dekhte hain. Sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke sawal humse do cheezein maang raha hai: ek unit vector jo dono vectors par perpendicular ho, aur dono ke darmiyan angle ka sine. Achhi baat yeh hai ke dono kaamon ki jaan ek hi cheez hai: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\). Is liye pehle wahi nikalenge, aur phir usi se dono jawab nikal aayenge. Is tarah ka 'ek hisaab, do faide' wala soch imtihan mein waqt bachata hai.

blocks.title: Example 16
blocks.problem: If \(\underline{a} = 4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{b} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\). Find a unit vector perpendicular to both \(\underline{a}\) and \(\underline{b}\). Also find the sine of the angle between the vectors \(\underline{a}\) and \(\underline{b}\).
steps:
Given: \(\underline{a} = 4\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{b} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\).
To find: (1) \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular unit vector; (2) un ke darmiyan angle ka sine.
Method: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) dono par perpendicular hai; use us ki apni lambai se divide karein to unit vector (lambai 1) ban jata hai. Phir \(\sin\theta = |\underline{a} \times \underline{b}| / (|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|)\). Dono kaamon mein \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) aur \(|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|\) chahiye, is liye pehle wahi nikalenge.

Step 1: \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) determinant se
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 4 & 3 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 & 2 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (6 + 1)\underline{i} - (8 - 2)\underline{j} + (-4 - 6)\underline{k}\]
\[= 7\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\): \(3 \cdot 2 - 1 \cdot (-1) = 7\); \(\underline{j}\): \(-(4 \cdot 2 - 1 \cdot 2) = -6\); \(\underline{k}\): \(4 \cdot (-1) - 3 \cdot 2 = -10\). Beech wale par minus yaad rakha.

Step 2: Is ki lambai
\[|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}| = \sqrt{7^{2} + (-6)^{2} + (-10)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{49 + 36 + 100} = \sqrt{185}\]
Kyun: magnitude ka formula \(\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}}\). Negative numbers ka square positive hota hai.

Step 3: Unit vector
\[\dfrac{\underline{a} \times \underline{b}}{|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|} = \dfrac{7\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}}{\sqrt{185}}\]
Kyun: kisi vector ko us ki apni lambai se divide karein to direction wahi rehti hai aur lambai 1 ho jati hai. (Kitab ne yahan numerator mein \(-6\underline{j}\) ki jagah ghalti se \(b\underline{j}\) chhapa hai; sahi \(-6\underline{j}\) hai.)

Step 4: \(|\underline{a}|\) aur \(|\underline{b}|\)
\[|\underline{a}| = \sqrt{4^{2} + 3^{2} + 1^{2}} = \sqrt{26}\]
\[|\underline{b}| = \sqrt{2^{2} + (-1)^{2} + 2^{2}} = 3\]
Kyun: sine ke formula ke denominator mein dono lambaiyan chahiye. \(\sqrt{9} = 3\).

Step 5: Angle ka sine
\[\sin\theta = \dfrac{|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|}{|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{185}}{3\sqrt{26}}\]
Kyun: \(|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}| = |\underline{a}||\underline{b}|\sin\theta\) ko \(\sin\theta\) ke liye hal kiya. Andaza: \(\sqrt{185} \approx 13.60\), \(3\sqrt{26} \approx 15.30\), to \(\sin\theta \approx 0.889\), jo 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan hai, jaisa hona chahiye.

Tasdeeq:
\[\underline{a} \cdot (7\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}) = 28 - 18 - 10 = 0\]
\[\underline{b} \cdot (7\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}) = 14 + 6 - 20 = 0\]
Dono zero, yani vector dono par perpendicular hai. Aur \(\cos\theta = \underline{a} \cdot \underline{b}/(|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|) = 7/(3\sqrt{26})\); \(\sin^{2}\theta + \cos^{2}\theta = (185 + 49)/234 = 1\). Sahi!

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Unit vector ka matlab hai lambai bilkul 1. Isi liye hum \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b}\) ko us ki apni lambai \(\sqrt{185}\) se divide karte hain. Bohat se students \(|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|\) se divide kar dete hain, jo ghalat hai: woh to sine wale formula ka denominator hai. Yaad rakhiye: unit vector ke liye vector ko apni hi lambai se divide karna hai. Aur jawab ko \(\sqrt{185}\) ke saath hi chhor dena theek hai; rationalize karna zaroori nahin.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 16 mein kitab ne unit vector \(\frac{7\underline{i} - b\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}}{\sqrt{185}}\) chhapa hai. Beech wala term \(-6\underline{j}\) hona chahiye, kyun ke \(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = 7\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}\). Sahi unit vector \(\frac{7\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 10\underline{k}}{\sqrt{185}}\) hai, jo upar likha hai.
Ab ek khoobsurat saboot: trigonometry ka mashhoor formula \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) hum vectors se saabit karenge.

Is saboot ka khayal yeh hai: ek hi cheez ko do mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalo, aur phir dono jawabon ko barabar rakh do. Pehla tareeqa definition hai, jis mein angle aata hai, yani \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\). Doosra tareeqa components wala determinant hai, jis mein \(\sin\alpha\), \(\cos\alpha\), \(\sin\beta\), \(\cos\beta\) aate hain. Jab dono barabar honge to formula khud ba khud saabit ho jayega. Figure ko pehle achhi tarah dekh lijiye: \(\overrightarrow{OA}\) \(x\)-axis se upar \(\alpha\) par hai aur \(\overrightarrow{OB}\) neeche \(\beta\) par.

blocks.title: Example 17
steps:
Given: \(xy\)-plane mein unit vectors \(\overrightarrow{OA}\) aur \(\overrightarrow{OB}\), jo positive \(x\)-axis se \(\alpha\) aur \(-\beta\) angle banate hain.
To prove: \(\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\).
Method: \(\overrightarrow{OB} \times \overrightarrow{OA}\) ko do tareeqon se nikalenge: (1) definition se, jo \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) dega; (2) components ke determinant se, jo \(\sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\) dega. Dono barabar honge, bas saboot mukammal.

Step 1: Dono ke darmiyan angle
\[m\angle AOB = \alpha + \beta\]
Kyun: \(\overrightarrow{OA}\) \(x\)-axis se \(\alpha\) upar hai aur \(\overrightarrow{OB}\) \(\beta\) neeche; dono ke beech poora faasla \(\alpha + \beta\).

Step 2: Components
\[\overrightarrow{OA} = \cos\alpha\,\underline{i} + \sin\alpha\,\underline{j}\]
\[\overrightarrow{OB} = \cos(-\beta)\,\underline{i} + \sin(-\beta)\,\underline{j}\]
\[= \cos\beta\,\underline{i} - \sin\beta\,\underline{j}\]
Kyun: lambai 1 wale vector ke components \((\cos\phi, \sin\phi)\) hote hain, jahan \(\phi\) us ka \(x\)-axis se angle hai. Aur \(\cos(-\beta) = \cos\beta\), \(\sin(-\beta) = -\sin\beta\).

Step 3: Cross product ki shakal
\[\overrightarrow{OB} \times \overrightarrow{OA}\]
\[= (\cos\beta\,\underline{i} - \sin\beta\,\underline{j}) \times (\cos\alpha\,\underline{i} + \sin\alpha\,\underline{j})\]
Kyun: Step 2 ke components rakh diye. (Kitab ne doosri bracket mein \(\sin\alpha\,\underline{j}\) ki jagah ghalti se \(\sin\alpha\,\underline{i}\) chhapa hai.)

Step 4: Definition aur determinant barabar
\[|\overrightarrow{OB}||\overrightarrow{OA}|\sin(\alpha + \beta)\,\underline{k}\]
\[= \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ \cos\beta & -\sin\beta & 0 \\ \cos\alpha & \sin\alpha & 0 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: dono vectors \(xy\)-plane mein hain, to cross product \(z\)-axis ki seedh mein hai. \(\overrightarrow{OB}\) se \(\overrightarrow{OA}\) ki taraf ungliyan modein to ghoomna anticlockwise hai aur angootha \(+\underline{k}\) ki taraf: is liye \(\underline{n} = \underline{k}\). Teesra component zero hai kyun ke vectors farsh par hain.

Step 5: Determinant kholiye
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta)\,\underline{k}\]
\[= (\sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta)\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(|\overrightarrow{OB}| = |\overrightarrow{OA}| = 1\). \(\underline{i}\) aur \(\underline{j}\) wale hisse zero hain (aakhri column ke zeros ki wajah se). \(\underline{k}\) wala hissa: \(\cos\beta\sin\alpha - (-\sin\beta)\cos\alpha\).

Step 6: \(\underline{k}\) ke coefficients barabar kijiye
\[\therefore\; \sin(\alpha + \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
Kyun: do barabar vectors ke components barabar hote hain.

Tasdeeq:
\(\alpha = \beta = 45^{\circ}\): baayan taraf \(\sin 90^{\circ} = 1\); daayan taraf \(\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2} + \tfrac{\sqrt2}{2}\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt2}{2} = 1\). Barabar!

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Is saboot mein do cheezon ka khaas khayal rakhiye. Pehli: \(\overrightarrow{OB} \times \overrightarrow{OA}\) liya gaya hai, \(\overrightarrow{OA} \times \overrightarrow{OB}\) nahin. Agar ulta lete to \(\underline{k}\) ki jagah \(-\underline{k}\) aata aur sign ki ulti baat ban jati. Doosri: \(\cos(-\beta) = \cos\beta\) lekin \(\sin(-\beta) = -\sin\beta\); cosine negative angle ko nazarandaz karta hai, sine nahin. Yahi minus aage determinant mein plus ban kar formula mein jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 17 mein kitab ne doosri bracket \((\cos\alpha\,\underline{i} + \sin\alpha\,\underline{i})\) chhapi hai. Doosra unit vector \(\underline{j}\) hona chahiye: \(\overrightarrow{OA} = \cos\alpha\,\underline{i} + \sin\alpha\,\underline{j}\). Kitab ka agla determinant sahi components istemal karta hai.

blocks.alt: Magenta x- and y-axes with origin O. Unit vector OA makes angle alpha above the positive x-axis; unit vector OB makes angle minus beta below it. Cyan curved arrows mark the two angles.
blocks.caption: Figure: unit vectors OA at angle α and OB at angle −β with the positive x-axis, Example 17 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Example 17 aur 18 jaise saboot wale sawalon mein imtihan ke andar har line ke saath us ki wajah likhiye (components kaise aaye, right hand rule se \(\underline{k}\) kyun, \(|\underline{n}| = 1\) kyun). Examiner sirf jawab nahin, wajah bhi dekhta hai.
Agla saboot Law of Sines ka hai, jo aap ne trigonometry mein parha hoga. Figure ko ghaur se dekhiye: vectors triangle ke gird ek hi simt mein ghoomte hain.

blocks.title: Example 18
blocks.problem: In any triangle \(ABC\), prove that \(\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{b}{\sin B} = \dfrac{c}{\sin C}\) (Law of Sines).
steps:
Given: triangle \(ABC\); vectors \(\underline{a}, \underline{b}, \underline{c}\) sides \(BC, CA, AB\) ke saath.
To prove: \(\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{b}{\sin B} = \dfrac{c}{\sin C}\) (Law of Sines).
Method: teeno vectors ek band chakkar banate hain, is liye in ka jama zero hai. Phir cross product le kar do cross products barabar milenge; un ki lambaiyan barabar karne se sines aa jayenge.

Step 1: Teeno vectors ka jama
\[\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\]
\[\Rightarrow \underline{b} + \underline{c} = -\underline{a} \quad \text{(i)}\]
Kyun: \(B\) se \(C\), \(C\) se \(A\), \(A\) se wapas \(B\): ghoom kar wahin aa gaye, to kul displacement zero.

Step 2: (i) ka \(\underline{c}\) ke saath cross product
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{c} + \underline{c} \times \underline{c} = -\underline{a} \times \underline{c}\]
\[\underline{b} \times \underline{c} = \underline{c} \times \underline{a} \quad (\because\, \underline{c} \times \underline{c} = \underline{0})\]
Kyun: \(\underline{c} \times \underline{c} = \underline{0}\), aur \(-\underline{a} \times \underline{c} = \underline{c} \times \underline{a}\) (tarteeb ulatne se sign badalta hai).

Step 3: Lambaiyan barabar
\[|\underline{b} \times \underline{c}| = |\underline{c} \times \underline{a}|\]
\[|\underline{b}||\underline{c}|\sin(\pi - A) = |\underline{c}||\underline{a}|\sin(\pi - B)\]
Kyun: \(\underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{c}\) ko tail to tail rakhein to un ke darmiyan angle triangle ka andar wala \(A\) nahin balke bahar wala \(\pi - A\) hai (figure dekhiye). Isi tarah \(\underline{c}\) aur \(\underline{a}\) ke darmiyan \(\pi - B\).

Step 4: Saada kijiye
\[bc\sin A = ca\sin B\]
\[\Rightarrow b\sin A = a\sin B\]
\[\therefore\; \dfrac{b}{\sin B} = \dfrac{a}{\sin A} \quad \text{(ii)}\]
Kyun: \(\sin(\pi - x) = \sin x\); \(|\underline{a}| = a\) waghera; dono taraf \(c\) se divide kiya, phir \(\sin A\sin B\) se.

Step 5: Isi tarah \(\underline{b}\) ke saath
\[\underline{a} \times \underline{b} + \underline{c} \times \underline{b} = \underline{0}\]
\[\Rightarrow \underline{a} \times \underline{b} = \underline{b} \times \underline{c}\]
\[ab\sin(\pi - C) = bc\sin(\pi - A)\]
\[\Rightarrow \dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{c}{\sin C} \quad \text{(iii)}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{a} + \underline{b} + \underline{c} = \underline{0}\) ka \(\underline{b}\) se cross product liya; \(\underline{b} \times \underline{b} = \underline{0}\). Kitab yahan sirf 'Similarly' likhti hai; yeh qadam humne bhar diye.

Step 6: (ii) aur (iii) milaiye
\[\dfrac{a}{\sin A} = \dfrac{b}{\sin B} = \dfrac{c}{\sin C}\]
Kyun: dono equations mein \(a/\sin A\) mushtarik hai.

Tasdeeq:
Equilateral triangle: \(a = b = c\), \(A = B = C = 60^{\circ}\); teeno nisbatein barabar. Ya \(3, 4, 5\) wala right triangle: \(5/\sin 90^{\circ} = 5\), \(3/(3/5) = 5\), \(4/(4/5) = 5\). Sahi!
blocks.answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C}\).

blocks.alt: Triangle ABC. Vector a runs along BC from B to C, vector b along CA from C to A, vector c along AB from A to B. Each side is extended past its end, showing the exterior angles pi minus A at A, pi minus B at B and pi minus C at C.
blocks.caption: Figure: vectors a, b, c along the sides of triangle ABC with exterior angles π − A, π − B, π − C, Example 18 (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Example 18 ka sab se nazuk hissa angle hai. Triangle ke andar kone \(A\) par angle \(A\) hai, lekin vectors \(\underline{b}\) (\(C\) se \(A\)) aur \(\underline{c}\) (\(A\) se \(B\)) ko jab ek hi nuqte se shuru karte hain to un ke darmiyan bahar wala angle \(\pi - A\) banta hai. Figure mein side ko kone se aage barha kar yahi angle dikhaya gaya hai. Khush qismati se \(\sin(\pi - A) = \sin A\), is liye aakhir mein farq nahin parta, lekin saboot likhte waqt sahi angle likhna zaroori hai, warna examiner number kaat sakta hai.
Aakhir mein determinant formula ki practice, jis se properties bhi apni aankhon se nazar aayengi.

blocks.title: Example 19
blocks.problem: If \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\) and \(\underline{v} = 4\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), find by determinant formula (i) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u}\) (ii) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\) (iii) \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\).
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} - \underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 4\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} - \underline{k}\).
To find: (i) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u}\), (ii) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\), (iii) \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) determinant formula se.
Method: har hisse mein row 2 mein pehla vector, row 3 mein doosra. Teeno jawab properties se bhi check honge.

(i) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u}\)
\[\underline{u} \times \underline{u} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix} = \underline{0}\]
Kyun: do rows bilkul ek jaisi hon to determinant zero hota hai (kitab: 'Two rows are same'). Har hissa \(xy - xy = 0\). Yeh property \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u} = \underline{0}\) hi hai.

(ii) \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v}\)
\[\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \\ 4 & 2 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (1 - 2)\underline{i} - (-2 - 4)\underline{j} + (4 + 4)\underline{k}\]
\[= -\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 8\underline{k}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\): \((-1)(-1) - (1)(2)\); \(\underline{j}\): \(-[(2)(-1) - (1)(4)]\); \(\underline{k}\): \((2)(2) - (-1)(4)\). Yeh wahi vectors hain jo Example 15 mein the, to jawab bhi wahi.

(iii) \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\)
\[\underline{v} \times \underline{u} = \begin{vmatrix} \underline{i} & \underline{j} & \underline{k} \\ 4 & 2 & -1 \\ 2 & -1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= (2 - 1)\underline{i} - (4 + 2)\underline{j} + (-4 - 4)\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 8\underline{k}\]
Kyun: ab \(\underline{v}\) pehle hai, to row 2 mein \(\underline{v}\). \(\underline{i}\): \((2)(1) - (-1)(-1) = 1\); \(\underline{j}\): \(-[(4)(1) - (-1)(2)] = -6\); \(\underline{k}\): \((4)(-1) - (2)(2) = -8\).

Tasdeeq:
\[\underline{v} \times \underline{u} = -(\underline{u} \times \underline{v})\]
\(\underline{i} - 6\underline{j} - 8\underline{k} = -(-\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 8\underline{k})\). Bilkul property \(\underline{u} \times \underline{v} = -\underline{v} \times \underline{u}\) ke mutabiq.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Example 19 teen baatein ek saath dikhata hai. (i) mein do rows ek jaisi hain, aur aisa determinant hamesha zero hota hai; yahi \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u} = \underline{0}\) hai. (ii) aur (iii) mein sirf rows ki jagah badli hai, aur jawab ka har component ulta ho gaya; yahi \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u} = -(\underline{u} \times \underline{v})\) hai. Imtihan mein agar (ii) nikaal liya ho to (iii) ke liye poora hisaab dobara karne ki zaroorat nahin, sirf sign badal dijiye, lekin wajah zaroor likhiye.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari misaal, kitab ka sawal nahin.) \(\underline{a} = \underline{i} + \underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{b} = \underline{j}\) ke darmiyan angle ka sine nikaliye.
\(\underline{a} \times \underline{b} = (\underline{i} + \underline{j}) \times \underline{j} = \underline{i} \times \underline{j} + \underline{j} \times \underline{j} = \underline{k}\), to \(|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}| = 1\).
\(|\underline{a}| = \sqrt2\), \(|\underline{b}| = 1\). \(\sin\theta = 1/\sqrt2\). Aur \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b} = 1 > 0\), yani angle acute: \(\theta = 45^{\circ}\). Figure bana kar dekhiye: \(\underline{i} + \underline{j}\) bilkul \(x\) aur \(y\) axes ke beech hai, to \(y\)-axis se \(45^{\circ}\) par hai. Sahi!

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Example 16 ke vectors ke liye kya \(\theta\) acute hai ya obtuse? (Jawab: \(\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b} = 8 - 3 + 2 = 7 > 0\), is liye acute.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\sin\theta = \frac{|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|}{|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|}\); muqable mein \(\cos\theta = \frac{\underline{a} \cdot \underline{b}}{|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|}\).
2. \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) par perpendicular unit vector \(\pm\frac{\underline{a} \times \underline{b}}{|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|}\) hai.
3. Triangle ke sides wale vectors ka jama \(\underline{0}\); do aise vectors ke darmiyan angle bahar wala \(\pi - A\) hota hai.
4. \(\underline{v} \times \underline{u} = -(\underline{u} \times \underline{v})\) aur \(\underline{u} \times \underline{u} = \underline{0}\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Sine formula mein \(|\underline{a}||\underline{b}|\) ki jagah \(|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|\) se divide kar dena, ya ulta likh dena.
2. Sirf sine se angle nikaal lena jab ke angle obtuse bhi ho sakta hai.
3. Example 18 mein \(\underline{b}\) aur \(\underline{c}\) ke darmiyan andar wala angle \(A\) likh dena; sahi \(\pi - A\) hai (jawab sirf is liye nahin badalta ke \(\sin(\pi - A) = \sin A\)).
4. Yeh samajhna ke perpendicular unit vector sirf ek hai: \(-\frac{\underline{a} \times \underline{b}}{|\underline{a} \times \underline{b}|}\) bhi utna hi sahi hai.
